Vapes in NYC

Vapes are the second-largest category on New York menus by a narrow margin, with about 8,870 listings across the 69 licensed dispensaries we track, from 245 brands. The category includes 510-thread cartridges, pod systems like PAX and Plug Play, and disposable all-in-ones in half-gram, one-gram, 1.5-gram and two-gram sizes. Jaunty leads with 626 listings, followed by STIIIZY at 574, Fernway at 572, Select at 404, Ayrloom at 403, MFNY at 376, Heavy Hitters at 372 and Rove at 370.

Prices start at $0.88, likely a battery or accessory, with half-gram disposables from about $25, one-gram cartridges $35 to $60 and premium all-in-ones from Fernway and Jetty $50 to $95 before tax. Midtown has by far the deepest selection at about 1,410 listings, led by Qube's 652, then Sheepshead Bay at 814, Chelsea and Flatiron at 784, the Villages at 478, the Upper West Side at 434 and Williamsburg at 407. Vapes are the top category in Midtown, Sheepshead Bay, Gramercy and Park Slope, and shops like Green Genius, Bud & Honey, Torches and The Flowery Brooklyn are built around them.

Vapes FAQ
What is the difference between a cartridge and an all-in-one?

A cartridge screws onto a separate rechargeable 510-thread battery and can be swapped out. An all-in-one, or disposable, has the battery built in and is discarded when empty. Pod systems like PAX and Plug Play use proprietary pods with their own battery.

Which vape brands are made in New York?

Jaunty, MFNY, Ayrloom, Florist Farms and Off Hours are New York companies. STIIIZY, Fernway, Select, Heavy Hitters, Rove and Jetty are out-of-state brands produced in New York under license, as the law requires for licensed sale.

Which dispensary has the most vapes?

Qube in Midtown, with about 652 listings. Twenty8gramz and Quality Control in Sheepshead Bay, Stash Master in Bushwick and The Flowery Upper West Side are the deepest outside Midtown.
